source_selection: fixed ascending public subject identifiers, no waveform-based selection
filter: per-window fourth-order Butterworth bandpass, forward-backward, then polyphase resampling to 100 Hz; edge effects retained and disclosed

qc.unknown_adc_rails: report unknown; do not fabricate clipping labels

method_contract.spectrum: 40 uniform 1-Hz power cells from 1 to 40 Hz, log10; no canonical physiological band or semantic labels
method_contract.waveform: mean-centered RMS-normalized 200-sample waveform; PCA 20 dimensions learned only from training
method_contract.time_frequency: log10 power at 2,4,...,40 Hz in each of four nonoverlapping 0.5-second subwindows

clusterer: KMeans, k-means++, n_init=1, max_iter=200; all seeds reported
ood_rule: distance to nearest center exceeds the 99th percentile training distance; report raw assignment and abstention separately
agreement: cross-method agreement at matched K and seed
training-centroid waveform and spectrum reconstruction relative to K=1
uncertainty: per-recording values and range; small descriptive pilot, no population universality confidence
primary_comparison: K=16, seed=17; all prespecified settings retained
